title: 받침 ㅅ·ㅈ·ㅊ·ㅌ·ㅎ은 [ㄷ]: 옷, 낮, 꽃, 밭
objective: You can read words ending in ㅅ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ or ㅎ, such as 옷, 낮, 꽃 and 밭, with the [ㄷ] sound.
summary: ㅅ, ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅌ and ㅎ as final consonants all sound like one short, stopped [ㄷ].

task.title: Read and compare sounds
task.line: Say each word aloud. Then write the sound in [ ] or circle your answer.

letters.as: 옷 [옫]: ends with the tongue stopped as for a d/t, with no release and no s sound.
낮 [낟], 꽃 [꼳]: no j or ch sound at the end.
밭 [받], 팥 [팓]: no puff of air (no t release) at the end. The tongue stops and holds.
히읗 [히읃], 놓 [녿]: no h sound at the end. Stop the tongue and hold it.

exercises: Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 다섯 ② 몇 ③ 팥 ④ 놓 (the stem of 놓다, said alone)
Do the two words have the same sound? Write Yes or No: ① 낫 – 낮 ② 밭 – 밥 ③ 곧 – 곳
Circle the word whose last sound is NOT [ㄷ]: ① 곳 · 팥 · 밤 ② 몇 · 무엇 · 강
You hear the sound below. Circle every spelling that makes this sound: ① [받]: 밭 · 박 · 반 ② [빋]: 빗 · 빛 · 빈
answers: ① Yes (both [낟]) ② No ([받] / [밥]) ③ Yes (both [곧])
